title: Allotment Watering Roster Setup
originalRequest: Establish a structured weekly watering roster and resource allocation plan for the community allotment plots.
latestMessage: Establish a structured weekly watering roster and resource allocation plan for the community allotment plots.

steps.title: Confirm Plot 1-15 Coverage Priority
steps.instruction: Could you confirm if plots 4 and 12 require daily watering, or if they should follow the standard alternate-day schedule?
steps.acceptance: Owner confirmation on specific plot watering frequencies.

steps.title: Verify Borehole Pump Restricted Hours
steps.instruction: Please provide the official daily operating times for the shared borehole pump so we can align the morning shift times.
steps.acceptance: Operating window hours provided by the user.

steps.title: Approve Crop Water Classifications
steps.instruction: Should brassicas be classified under high water demand alongside tomatoes, or can they be managed on the medium tier?
steps.acceptance: User decision on brassica watering classification.

steps.title: Confirm Rainwater Tank Reserve Threshold
steps.instruction: At what remaining capacity (e.g., 20% or 30%) should we trigger the transition from mains water to the reserve rainwater tanks?
steps.acceptance: Trigger threshold percentage defined by the user.

steps.title: Verify Key Exchange Location
steps.instruction: Is the combination lockbox next to the main gate the agreed location for leaving the tap keys between shifts?
steps.acceptance: Confirmation of the physical key exchange location.

steps.title: Approve Volunteer Roster Draft
steps.instruction: Please review the drafted July roster. Are there any restricted dates where you cannot provide emergency backup cover?
steps.acceptance: Approval of the July draft and user's blackout dates marked.
